title: Emoji Metadata
description: Every fully-qualified RGI emoji with its CLDR name, group, subgroup, Unicode emoji version, skin-tone support and hex codepoints.

id.description: Hex codepoints joined with dashes, used as the record id

version.description: Emoji version the emoji was introduced in

skinToneSupport.description: True if the emoji takes a skin-tone modifier

skinToneVariants.description: Number of skin-tone variants published for this emoji

tone.description: Skin tone of this record, when it is a tone variant

base.description: Record id of the base emoji, when this record is a tone variant

status.description: UTS #51 status of the form, always fully-qualified here
